# A review date before the day the policy came into force

`Policy: pol-REVW` `ACTIVE`

## Purpose

To state a `review-by` earlier than its own `active-from`. A policy is read again some time after it starts
binding, so a review date before the commencement date is one of the two written wrong.

## Scope

This fixture only.

## Clauses

| Id      | Clause                                        | Alignment |
|---------|-----------------------------------------------|-----------|
| `ORDER` | **MUST** come into force before it is reviewed |           |
